scientific_choices.rationale: Keep the qualified decoder and copy only head channel1 into one output. Verify native threshold masks against every frozen source export. Source was trained jointly on Text and Kernel; no kernel-only training claim.
Threshold only Kernel at0.5 on the RGB canvas, without Text gating, learned Gap, dilation, area filter, top10 or region growth.
Reuse the existing six-value grid0/2/4/6/8/12 in native256 pixels before inverse letterbox mapping. Evaluate only the frozen TRAIN holdout; no TEST inputs or tuning.

Report both raw detection-box geometry and padded-box geometry; OCR joint correctness uses the padded RGB crop box. Keep every care GT and maximum one-to-one matching; exclude wholly invalid predictions only after GT-blind decoding.
Single RTX3090 instead of3070 target; FP32, TF32off, batch8. Release segmentation before PARSeq and record per-stage memory.
Reused1130/125 TRAIN split and one source checkpoint; no dedicated kernel-only training, independent validation or official benchmark result.
